// diagnostic

E0363

`{type}` can't be a union member.

What

`{type}` can't be a union member.

Why

Anonymous unions hold concrete closed member types only — not type parameters, trait objects, or function types.

Fix

Use a named enum when a member needs an open shape.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0363: tests/ui/union_case_reuses_type_name.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidUnionMember]: `Kelvin(Float)` can't be a union member
  --> tests/ui/union_case_reuses_type_name.jet:4:18
    |
  4 | reading: fn() -> Kelvin(Float) | Kelvin { .Kelvin(1.5) }
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The named case `Kelvin` reuses the name of a member type of this union
 Fix: Rename the case so no member type of the union has its name
